meta.source_provenance: Email from PC Jon Dixon to Ben Carter on 12 Feb 2025 at 14:17

emails.body:
Hi Ben

It’s understandable to have concerns and worries, if you need additional support let me know and I can make referrals.

As per our conversation yesterday I can confirm that Alanna is still on bail. This was what is called Initial Bail to start with but as of 2nd February 2025 this bail period has been extended till 4th May 2025. The conditions to not contact you or attend your address remain the same, if she sees you in the street or at a venue for example, she must make all reasonable effort to leave as soon as she becomes aware. The bail conditions apply to protect you as you are the victim and will remain as such while the investigation is ongoing.

contradiction_links.reality: This clarification was necessary to correct ambiguity in an earlier message.

events: Dixon resends bail confirmation with explicit clarification that conditions protect the victim.
